main_measure.name: mean next-bar return in-stretch minus out-of-stretch
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference > 0 with Welch t >= 2; reject if difference < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; needs >= 100 in-stretch bars, >= 100 out-of-stretch bars, >= 3 distinct up-cross stretches

supporting_check.name: share of up next-bars in-stretch minus out-of-stretch

decided_by: The difference is negative with t <= -2, so moves after up crosses reverse.
reading: Distinct up-cross stretches are counted as contiguous runs of raw spread > 0 within each window, a run starting at a window's first row included. The supporting check passes when its difference is > 0.
